name: L25_unload_from_proof_point
description: Unloading from the proof point leaves exactly the offset as permanent strain: the meaning of a 0.2 % proof strength.
derivation: eps_p = 0.00325 - 250/200000 = 0.002; after unloading to zero stress eps = eps_p = 0.002 (0.2 % residual strain). The offset is a residual strain, not the total strain at the proof point (0.325 %).
